title: rulecad section outline
description: A profile's measured section as closed loops, kept beside its rule set as rules/outlines/<set name>.json. The outside of the metal and each hole are loops of [x, y] points in mm, x across and y up, with the middle of the section's envelope at the origin. It says what it was measured from and under what licence: the kit draws its own outlines, so a maker's model is measured in your own workspace and its shape is never copied into the kit.

name.description: The rule set it belongs to

source.description: What it was measured from: a model's file and where that came from, or a bar and how it was measured

licence.description: The terms the source came with

checked.description: The date it was measured, YYYY-MM-DD

loops.description: Closed loops, the last point joining the first. Either way round: a loop inside an odd number of others is a hole
